title: Momentum and Collisions
main_stem: Two blocks slide directly towards each other along a frictionless horizontal surface, as shown in Fig. 4.1. The blocks collide and then move as shown in Fig. 4.2. Block X initially moves to the right with a momentum of $0.37\,\text{kg m s}^{-1}$. Block Y initially moves to the left with a momentum of $0.65\,\text{kg m s}^{-1}$. After the blocks collide, block X moves to the left back along its original path with a momentum of $0.13\,\text{kg m s}^{-1}$. Block Y also moves to the left after the collision.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Block X has an initial kinetic energy of $0.30\,\text{J}$. Calculate the mass of block X.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude of the momentum of block Y after the collision.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Block X exerts an average force of $7.7\,\text{N}$ on block Y during the collision. Calculate the time that the blocks are in contact with each other.
